example_sentences_in_bangla: সে লোকনাথের উপর ভরসা করে জীবনের সকল সমস্যা মোকাবিলা করে।
example_sentences_in_english: He relies on the Loknath to overcome all life's problems.
In natural disasters, we seek the grace of the Lord of the Universe.
history: লোকনাথ is a traditional epithet for Lord Shiva in Bengali Hindu traditions, symbolizing the protector of all beings.
note: This term is often used in devotional contexts in Bengali literature and folklore.
